description.value: Tap & Barrel's Olympic Village location is the group's original restaurant, perched in the heart of one of Vancouver's most cycle-centric neighbourhoods with unobstructed views of False Creek and the downtown skyline. The company operates its own brewery, BREWHALL Beer Co., and is recognised for an award-winning BC wine list and a tap system designed to eliminate single-use bottles. Large indoor spaces and a patio that doubles capacity in summer make it a natural rest stop on the False Creek seawall loop.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Tap & Barrel is an active multi-location BC restaurant group; the front page and contact page both identify this Olympic Village location as the original. The website contact page lists the Olympic Village address as '75 Athletes Way' while OSM records '1 Athletes Way' — a clear discrepancy flagged in concerns and resolved in favour of the website. Takeout is confirmed by the site-wide 'ORDER TAKEOUT & DELIVERY' navigation element; dietary accommodation is confirmed by the menu page's explicit diet-filter feature; all other WWC amenity fields lack any explicit evidence in either the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: Address mismatch: OSM records '1 Athletes Way' but the official website contact page lists the Olympic Village location as '75 Athletes Way, Vancouver, V5Y 0B1'. Website value used in the address field.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active full-service pub and restaurant in Olympic Village, a cycling hub on the False Creek seawall; confirmed takeout and dietary options make it a practical stop for touring cyclists. Address discrepancy should be resolved before publishing.
